_note: Declared seed banks. A seed's bank decides what it may be USED for; the live scan in
seed_registry.py decides whether that promise was kept. Ranges are inclusive on both ends.
eval-only  MUST NOT appear in any training corpus (datasets/*/meta.jsonl). A single hit is
contamination and fails `seed_registry.py check` — this is the CI gate.
train      Harvestable into training corpora. A cited eval MUST NOT draw from these, whether
or not the specific seed has been harvested yet: the whole band is the harvest pool.
harness    Zero-model / mechanical validation (canary, smoke, plumbing). Never a strength claim,
so contamination is meaningless here; also not usable for a cited eval.
An eval-only bank may also declare `burned`: seeds inside it that were harvested (or played by a
corpus-generating run) BEFORE the band was declared eval-only. This mirrors the `grandfathered`
list in eval/holdouts.json — pre-declaration contamination is frozen and labeled, not hidden.
Burned seeds do NOT fail the contamination check, because that damage is already done and
recording it is the point; they ARE refused for any cited eval. The asymmetry with decks is
deliberate: a held-out deck is scarce and worth grandfathering, a clean seed costs nothing.
Seeds outside every bank classify as 'unregistered': allowed in exploratory work, refused for a
cited eval. Declaring the band is how a seed becomes usable, which is the point — it makes the
train/eval split a thing someone decided, not a thing that emerged from whatever was typed.

banks.name: eval-holdout
banks.purpose: Flagship held-out eval. This band was declared by eval/suites/stage3-v1.json's seed_policy, which required it to move under this registry once the registry existed; that is what this entry does. 9100-9102 are burned: runs/d4-dagger-r1 played them and datasets/stage2-local-v1-dagger harvested them. 9001 is burned too: runs/d4-dagger-pilot played it and DAgger runs exist to be harvested, so treating it as clean would be optimistic. stage3-v1's forge-ai-ur-delver arm starts at 9100 and therefore currently overlaps the burned seeds — shift that arm before running it cited.

banks.name: eval-holdout-2
banks.purpose: Reserve bank, deliberately untouched. Chosen as a virgin band: the highest seed appearing anywhere in runs/ was 9102 and in datasets/ was 6529 on 2026-07-26, so nothing here can be retroactively burned. Use it if eval-holdout's burn list grows enough to make that band awkward.

banks.name: canary
banks.purpose: Floor-mirror regression canary (identity A wins after 108 turns, bit-reproducible). See CLAUDE.md validation ladder step 1.

banks.name: smoke
banks.purpose: Smoke batches: floor-vs-random, floor-vs-ai, haiku-vs-* plumbing runs.

banks.name: train-stage0
banks.purpose: Stage-0 teacher calibration and the A/B preamble/quality runs. Harvested into datasets/stage1-v0 and datasets/stage1-v1. runs/stage0-calibration, stage1-student-eval and stage2-student-eval all drew 501-525 from here, which is why those student win rates are not defensible as held-out measurements.

banks.name: train-selfplay
banks.purpose: D1 self-play and the R2 teacher breadth/burn corpora. Harvested into datasets/stage2-local-v0 and datasets/stage2-local-v1-dagger. Stops at 8999 so it does not collide with the eval-holdout band above; the D4 DAgger rounds that already ran at 9001/9100-9102 predate that boundary and are recorded as eval-holdout's burn list.
